Build a formatted results table

Source: R/table.R
cr_table.Rd

Creates a table object that prints in the console, renders natively in Quarto/R Markdown (HTML, Word, and PDF), and can be passed to cr_save(). Printing a clean_results object directly uses the defaults below.

Usage

cr_table(
  x,
  style = "apa",
  uncertainty = NULL,
  p = NULL,
  layout = NULL,
  contrasts = c("include", "exclude", "only"),
  digits = 2,
  p_digits = 3,
  fit = TRUE,
  random = TRUE,
  show_model_type = TRUE,
  note = NULL,
  auto_note = TRUE,
  effect_size = FALSE,
  omit = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A clean_results object from clean_regress().

style

Preset: "apa", "stargazer", or "compact" (see table). "ci" and "se" are accepted as aliases for "apa" and "stargazer".

uncertainty

"ci", "se", or "none".

p

"value" (a p column), "stars" (stars on the estimate, no p column), "both", or "none".

layout

How the estimate and its uncertainty share space: "columns" (separate columns), "stacked" (uncertainty on the line below the estimate), or "inline" (one cell: 0.46 (0.21) or 0.46 [0.04, 0.89]).

contrasts

"include" (contrasts as a section of this table), "exclude" (leave them out, e.g. to report them in a separate table), or "only" (a contrasts-only table; see cr_contrast_table()).

digits

Decimal places for estimates, CIs, SEs, and fit statistics.

p_digits

Decimal places for p-values (APA: no leading zero).

fit, random

Show the model-fit and random-effects blocks.

show_model_type

Show the model type under each outcome name.

note

Extra note lines appended under the automatic note.

auto_note

Include the automatic methods note.

effect_size

Add a Cohen's d column for linear models (factor levels and contrasts).

omit

Regular expression matched against model term labels (the variable column of cr_tidy(), e.g. "Topic", "Month", "age:condition"): matching rows are left out of the table, typically nuisance controls. They stay in the fitted models and in cr_tidy(), cr_report(), and cr_ground_truth(). With auto_note = TRUE the note lists them ("Also controls for: ...").

Value

An object of class cr_table.

Details

Start from a style preset and override any piece:

styleuncertaintyplayout
"apa" (default)"ci""value""columns"
"stargazer""se""stars""stacked"
"compact""ci""stars""inline"

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cr_table(res)                                   # APA: b, 95% CI, p
cr_table(res, uncertainty = "se")               # b, SE, p
cr_table(res, p = "stars")                      # stars instead of a p column
cr_table(res, uncertainty = "se", layout = "inline", p = "stars")  # 0.46* (0.21)
cr_table(res, style = "stargazer")              # stacked SEs with stars
cr_table(res, contrasts = "exclude")            # main table without contrasts
cr_contrast_table(res)                          # contrasts in their own table
cr_table(res, omit = "^(region|wave)$")         # hide nuisance controls
} # }
